## Description

A clear description of the error or issue.

## Location

- **File**: (e.g., `docs/en/invoices.md`)
- **Section**: (e.g., "Create Invoice")
- **Line**: (if applicable)

## Expected

What the documentation should say or how the example should work.

## Actual

What the documentation currently says or how the example actually behaves.

## Suggested Fix

If you have a suggestion for how to fix this issue.

## Additional Context

Any other information that might be helpful.
